name: What interior remodel upgrades help with storage in small homes?

mainEntity.name: What interior remodeling upgrades create the most storage in small homes without making rooms feel crowded?
mainEntity.text: What interior remodeling upgrades create the most storage in small homes without making rooms feel crowded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small homes benefit most from storage solutions that use vertical and hidden space instead of adding bulk. Built-in cabinets, custom closets, recessed shelving, toe-kick drawers, and full-height millwork can increase storage without shrinking the room visually. In many Los Angeles homes, a remodel can also improve storage by rethinking circulation, opening up dead corners, or combining functions in one area. The key is to design storage around what the household actually owns and uses, not just to add cabinets everywhere. Too much closed storage in a small room can make it feel heavier, so balance matters. A thoughtful remodel should increase organization while keeping the space open and comfortable.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best storage upgrades for small homes usually include built-in cabinetry, floor-to-ceiling storage, recessed niches, better closet organization, and furniture-style millwork that uses dead space. Vertical storage and custom solutions often work better than adding bulky freestanding furniture. Good design keeps pathways open while maximizing usable wall space.
